description:
We are looking for Mid-Level Java Developer in Bethesda, MD for Fulltime position. 
 

 Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $2500!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who are looking for projects.
 

 Job details mentioned below
 Title: Mid-Level Java Developer
 Location: Bethesda, MD
 Duration : Full Time
 

 

 Role & Responsibility :
 • Strong J2EE application full life cycle development experience including specifying, building and deploying on Application servers and Web Services applications
 • Solid knowledge and experience in XML/JAXP
 • Strong Analysis experience including Rational Unified Process (RUP), Domain Modeling, Use Cases, Data Patterns, etc.
 • Strong relational Data Base knowledge/experiences such as Oracle database. Demonstrated experiences in understanding and writing complex queries, stored procedures, and best practices in programming for relational databases
 • Design Skills includes Infrastructure and Feature definition, Componentization, Object Oriented Design using UML, User Interface Design and API’s for System Integration of COTS
 • Programming in Java, EJB, J2EE, PL/SQL, SQL, XML, XSLT, Perl, JavaScript
 • Experiences in UNIX platform, Linux, Window NT, etc.
 • Experience with tools such as Eclipse, Rational Rose, Visio, Toad, SVN
 • Ability to understand/pick up business domain knowledge within a short time period
 • Good verbal communication. Good writing skills such as writing systems or application documentation
 • Good team player and is willing to work with domain people (non-IT) as well as Developers and Team Leaders
 • Any UMLS, Medical or medical drug knowledge is plus
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
